title: Noble
html:
Noble is a character background. Minthara and the hireling Kerz have this background.

“
You were raised in a family among the social elite, accustomed to power and privilege. Accumulating renown, power, and loyalty will raise your status.
„

Background features

  • History Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Intelligence (History) Ability Checks.
  • Persuasion Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Charisma (Persuasion) Ability Checks.

Background goals

Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration. These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points.

Location XP Reward Name Description
General
Anywhere 25 Dragon's Hoard Have at least 2000 gold among the party.
  • Only obtainable the first time the threshold of 2000 gold is reached.
30 Eldritch Authority Become a True Soul. Use illithid dialogue options in conversations 7 times.[1]
20 Fine By Me Use your wealth to bribe a guard.
20 Noblesse Oblige Dismiss a companion for interrupting a conversation or Ignore the pleas or requests of a companion in dialogue.
  • This only works as a Custom party member,[verify] and does not work with Hirelings or Minthara.
  • It is possible to let Lae'zel make Zorru bow or kneel once to get approval, and then step in after.
25 Penchant for Diplomacy Reach a High level of approval with a companion. Does not work with Hirelings.
20 Soul for Sale Acquire a Soul Coin for your personal collection.
  • The earliest options to earn this are looting a coin from the chest in the Dank Crypt or convincing Nadira in the Emerald Grove.
Act 1
Multiple locations 25 Entitled Earn a title from your deeds.

This can be awarded by doing the following:

  • Killing the duergar for Sovereign Spaw.
  • Persuading Kagha to abandon the Shadow Druids, thus earning the title "Faithwarden" (available only for a Druid characters).
  • Earning the "Mahkloompah" title from the Kuo-toa in Festering Cove does not grant this inspiration.
Blighted Village 25 Bodyguards for Hire Recruit the ogres to protect you.
  • Shared with ⁠Pyramid Scheme and ⁠Creatures of Bloodlust.
Campsite 30 Blueblood Solidarity Learn Wyll's family history.
  • This only works as a Custom party member,[verify] and does not work with Hirelings.
  • Wyll must be spoken with after saving Counsellor Florrick at Waukeen's Rest.
20 Lest Ye Be Judged Learn Astarion's history as a magistrate.
  • This only works as a Custom party member,[verify] and does not work with Hirelings.
Goblin Camp 25 A Man of Many Talents Expand your retinue by bringing Volo to camp.
Underdark 30 Know Your Place Leverage the player character's role in the drow matriarchy to force Dhourn to abandon his quest.
  • The dialogue option to do this can be made available to non-Drow characters through the use of Disguise Self.
Waukeen's Rest 30 Protector of the Duke Rescue Counsellor Florrick from the burning inn.
  • This is earned after speaking to Counsellor Florrick.
Act 2
Gauntlet of Shar 60 Meat Shield Obtain Balthazar's bell and summon his flesh golem.
  • The inspiration is not granted on attempt to summon Flesh in a battle against Balthazar himself.
75 Recognised by Shadows Pass all of Shar's trials.
Last Light Inn 60 Favour for a Favour Wake Art for Counsellor Florrick and the Flaming Fist.
50 Noble Feline Speak with the lordly cat at Last Light.
  • Only obtainable the first time a character speaks with His Majesty.
60 Patrician of the Grove Recruit Halsin.
Moonrise Towers 50 A Velvet Glove Spare the goblins.
  • Mutually exclusive with the ⁠An Iron Fist inspiration.
  • Shared with the ⁠Newly Downtrodden inspiration.
50 An Iron Fist Execute the goblins.
  • Mutually exclusive with the ⁠A Velvet Glove inspiration.
  • Shared with the ⁠Too Easy inspiration.
50 Can't Bribe 'Em All Bribe Moonrise's warden.
75 Ketheric's Loss Learn Ketheric's past.
  • Read the letter in the locked chest at the foot of Kethric's bed and investigate the plaque in front of Isobel's sarcophagus.
60 Nobleborn as Below, so Above Recruit Minthara.
60 Top of the Ladder Meet Ketheric at the top of Moonrise.
Reithwin Town 50 Taxes? Never Heard of 'Em Don't give any gold to the toll collector.
  • This effectively means fighting her, as any ability checks which convince her to "retire" require tossing her several coins first.
Shadow-Cursed Lands 50 Odd Entourage Complete the drider escort to Moonrise.
Act 3
Multiple locations 170 An Apocalyptic Deal Convince someone to aid you during the endgame or by making a deal with Raphael

This can be awarded by:

  • Convincing Mol or Nine-Fingers to aid the party in the battle for Baldur's Gate.
  • Defeating Raphael in the House of Hope, while first convincing Yurgir to join the party's side.
  • Siding with Wulbren Bongle during Disable the Steel Watch.
  • Recruiting Auntie Ethel as an ally.
Lower City 220 Defamed No More Sabotage the printing press.
170 The Means of Coercion Find the true reason the Gondians are cooperating with Gortash.
  • Awarded by witnessing the conversation between Gondian Lowa and Black Gauntlet Tamia Holzt when first entering the Steel Watch Foundry.
135 Updating Your Wardrobe Obtain a sumptuous new garment from Figaro's.
  • Granted only upon trading with Figaro Pennygood himself. Trading with Phlanders Hort if Figaro died does not count.
170 Wine Connoisseur Warn Mrs Highberry of the poisoned wine.
Murder Tribunal 220 Titles for the Collection Become the Unholy Assassin of Bhaal.
Rivington 125 Alms for the Unfortunate Donate something to the refugees.
  • Shared with ⁠Sharing the Spoils and ⁠Spare What You Can inspirations.
135 Exerting Judgement End the squabbling between the merchant and the squatters.
  • If letting the Rivington Rats deal with the squatters, the inspiration is not given.
135 Press Release Complete Lens' interview.
  • Only obtainable if Orin is impersonating Lens.[verify][2]
  • Shared with ⁠Blabbermouth and ⁠Free Advertisement inspirations.
135 The Right Oil for Any Situation Gain access to the circus.
  • The inspiration cannot be gained if the party have already entered the circus' territory through an alternative route (e.g., from the Open Hand Temple). In this case, the gatekeeper Klaus behaves as if they have already convinced him.
170 Interrupted Communications Discover where the missing letters went.
170 Newfound Subject Feed a brain to the freshly turned mindflayer.
  • Shared with ⁠Unexpected Parenting inspiration.
170 Backing the Established Players Side with the Guild during the confrontation.
  • Shared with ⁠Stacking the Deck inspiration.
Undercity 170 Underbelly Diplomat Gain access to the Undercellar.
  • Shared with ⁠Friends in Low Places inspiration.
220 The Wealth of Morality Choose your allegiance between the Guild and the Zhentarim.
  • Granted for picking either side during the final confrontation in the Aid the Underduke quest.
  • Roah Moonglow or Friol must survive and escape on the previous stage of the quest.[verify]
Wyrm's Rock Fortress 170 Multipass Use the urgent Ravengard missive to pass the Flaming Fist checkpoint.
  • This document is at Sword Coast Couriers on a cabinet behind Danzo Arkwright.
  • Shared with ⁠Rock-Solid Alibi inspiration.
170 Procedures be Damned Enter Wyrm's Rock without a pass.
  • Shared with ⁠Through Nooks and Crannies inspiration.

Notes and references

  1. ↑ The game can bug and give the "True Soul" tag earlier than intended.
  2. ↑ The dialogue file with real Lens does not have the "WYR_OrinsImpersonation_CompletedLensInterview" tag (WYR_OrinsImpersonation_OrinJournalist, WYR_OrinsImpersonation_Journalist.)
